author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices counting to three, finding E and D, echoing short tunes and playing together, with a classic counting rhyme.

classes.title: Sway and knock-knock
classes.goal: Hear the whole rhyme, sway to the beat and knock at 'door'.

mathTarget.parentLine: Feeling a beat that comes again and again, evenly spaced

classes.parentPrompt: Sway side by side; knock gently on your knees at 'knock at the door'.
classes.childAction: Sway with the song and knock on your knees at 'door'.
classes.bridge: Every beat is a footstep, walking from one all the way to ten.

intro.caption: Let's sway and count along
intro.parentCue: knock gently on your knees at 'door'.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: feeling the steady beat, together.

classes.title: One, two, tap, tap
classes.goal: Tap one steady tap on each beat while the grown-up plays the tune.

mathTarget.parentLine: One tap for each beat, no more, no less

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand on your child's hand; tap together, then slowly let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key once for every beat you hear.
classes.bridge: Each beat is one stepping stone; one tap lands on each stone.

intro.caption: One beat, one tap
intro.parentCue: tap your child's shoulder on each beat.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one tap for each beat.

classes.title: E, the buckle key
classes.goal: Find E by touching the two black keys, then sliding right.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two black keys help us find the same key every time

classes.parentPrompt: Guide your child's finger to touch two black keys, then slide right to E.
classes.childAction: Find the two black keys, slide right, and buckle on E!
classes.bridge: E sits just right of the two black keys, like a shoe by the door.

intro.caption: Let's find the buckle key
intro.parentCue: touch the two black keys together first.

games.caption: Buckle my shoe: E, E, E

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding E by the two black keys.

classes.title: Three knocks at the door
classes.goal: Echo short patterns and hear how many same notes there are.

mathTarget.parentLine: Knowing two or three right away, without counting one by one

classes.parentPrompt: Knock three times on your child's knee, then point: your turn to knock.
classes.childAction: Listen to the knocks, then play the same number back.
classes.bridge: Three same notes are three knocks on one door: knock, knock, knock.

intro.caption: Knock, knock, who's there?
intro.parentCue: knock three times on your child's knee.

games.caption: Knock at the door: F, F, F
games.parentCue: Hold up three fingers as it plays

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing and playing two or three.

classes.title: Up the stairs, one more step
classes.goal: Echo a little tune, then the same tune starting one step higher.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same little tune starts one step higher each time

classes.parentPrompt: Walk your fingers up one stair on your child's arm for each new line.
classes.childAction: Echo the little tune, then echo it one key higher.
classes.bridge: Each line climbs one stair: C, D, E, then D, E, F.

intro.caption: The tune climbs the stairs
intro.parentCue: walk your fingers up your child's arm.

games.caption: First stair: C, D, E
games.parentCue: Point to each key as it lights

games.caption: One step up: D, E, F

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing a tune repeat one step higher.

classes.title: Wait for the buckle
classes.goal: Listen to the song and play E at the right moments.

mathTarget.parentLine: Waiting for your part is part of the music

classes.parentPrompt: Play the blue keys; nod to your child just before each E.
classes.childAction: Wait and listen, then play E when it's your turn.
classes.bridge: The tune walks along; E is the buckle you click shut.

intro.caption: Listen for the buckle key
intro.parentCue: nod to your child just before each E.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: waiting for your turn, then playing.

classes.title: E and D, next-door keys
classes.goal: Play two special notes, E and D, when they light up in the song.

mathTarget.parentLine: Hearing and seeing which of two notes comes next

classes.parentPrompt: Point to E or D just before it lights, then let your child play it.
classes.childAction: Play E or D when its key lights up in the song.
classes.bridge: E and D are neighbours: D sits right between the two black keys.

intro.caption: Now we have two keys
intro.parentCue: point to E, then D, before the song starts.

games.caption: Next-door keys: E, then D
games.parentCue: Point to the key before it lights

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: telling E and D apart in a song.

classes.title: Buckle up, play together
classes.goal: Play the whole song together, the grown-up on the tune, the child on E and D.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two players keep the same beat, so the song stays together

classes.parentPrompt: Keep playing even if a note is missed; nod the beat with your head.
classes.childAction: Play your E and D while your grown-up plays the rest.
classes.bridge: You and your grown-up walk side by side, step for step.

intro.caption: Let's play it together
intro.parentCue: keep going, even if a note is missed.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping one beat with two players.

classes.title: Shoe concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy, from 'one, two' to 'big fat hen', then bow.

mathTarget.parentLine: The tune climbs up for three lines, then walks back home

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; play the whole rhyme, then clap and bow together.
classes.childAction: Play your keys to the very end, then take a big bow.
classes.bridge: Up the stairs from one to six, then back down home to ten.

intro.caption: Concert time for teddy!
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, start to end.
